review: 702.43b: the skip claimed no Forge creature can have two instances of modular, but Blaster, Combat DJ grants modular 1 to Arcbound Worker, which already has it. Removed the skip and added scenario 702.43b-1.

scenarios.title: A dying modular permanent moves its +1/+1 counters onto a target artifact creature
decisions: B casts Lightning Bolt targeting Arcbound Worker, tapping Mountain; both players pass and it resolves.
Arcbound Worker dies in the state-based check; its modular trigger targets Ornithopter and A chooses to put the counters on it; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: artifact_target
variants.expected: Arcbound Worker is put into A's graveyard. The modular trigger fires and Ornithopter gets one +1/+1 counter, a 1/3.

variants.label: no_artifact_creature
variants.delta: A controls Grizzly Bears instead of Ornithopter.
variants.expected: Arcbound Worker dies. The trigger has no legal target (Grizzly Bears is not an artifact creature) and is not put on the stack; Grizzly Bears stays a 2/2.

variants.label: three_counters
variants.delta: Arcbound Worker has three +1/+1 counters, a 3/3 that Lightning Bolt still kills.
variants.expected: Arcbound Worker dies and Ornithopter gets three +1/+1 counters, a 3/5.

scenarios.title: A modular permanent enters with N +1/+1 counters
decisions: A casts the creature in hand, paying its cost from the Mountains.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: modular_1
variants.expected: Arcbound Worker enters with one +1/+1 counter, a 1/1.

variants.label: modular_3
variants.delta: The card in hand is Arcbound Bruiser (modular 3), cast for {5}.
variants.expected: Arcbound Bruiser enters with three +1/+1 counters, a 3/3.

variants.label: counters_prevented
variants.delta: B controls Solemnity, and the card in hand is Arcbound Worker.
variants.expected: Arcbound Worker enters without its counter, a 0/0, and dies in the state-based check; nothing is left on the battlefield.

variants.label: no_modular
variants.delta: The card in hand is Memnite, cast for {0}.
variants.expected: Memnite enters as a 1/1 with no counters; modular is not involved.

scenarios.title: A creature with two instances of modular enters with the counters of each

setup.notes: Blaster, Combat DJ is on its front face and gives other nontoken artifact creatures A controls modular 1, so Arcbound Worker has modular 1 twice.

decisions: A casts Arcbound Worker, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Arcbound Worker resolves.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Arcbound Worker enters with two +1/+1 counters, a 2/2.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: A does not control Blaster, Combat DJ.
variants.expected: Arcbound Worker enters with one +1/+1 counter, a 1/1.

scenarios.forge_notes: Depends on Forge applying a granted modular's enters-with-counters replacement to a permanent entering under the granting static (rule 614.12).
